projects.title: RedGuard
projects.summary: An IoT mobile application for monitoring and controlling connected devices.
projects.description: RedGuard is a new generation of intelligent security systems based on the Internet of Things (IoT). This burglar alarm system for places is entirely independent. The SIM card installed on it allows Internet connection, SMS, and voice calls to send security alerts and control electrical equipment.

projects.title: SmartTech+
projects.summary: A Flutter-based IoT application for remotely monitoring, managing, and controlling connected smart security devices.
projects.description: SmartTech+ is an IoT-based mobile application designed to provide centralized access to connected security devices. It bridges hardware and software, enabling users to interact with their security systems through an intuitive mobile experience.
